perks.name: Ensemble
perks.description: Improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

enhanced.name: Ensemble
enhanced.description: Substantially improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

perks.name: Fragile Focus
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

enhanced.name: Fragile Focus
enhanced.description: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns more quickly once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

perks.name: Genesis
perks.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon fills its magazine from reserves. Energy weapons regenerate ammo on hit when matching the damage type to the combatant's shield.

enhanced.name: Genesis
enhanced.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon fills its magazine from reserves. Energy weapons regenerate ammo on hit when matching the damage type to the combatant's shield. Also increases weapon handling.

perks.name: Compulsive Reloader
perks.description: Grants increased reload speed when close to full magazine.

enhanced.name: Compulsive Reloader
enhanced.description: Grants greatly increased reload speed when close to full magazine.

perks.name: Triple Tap
perks.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

enhanced.name: Triple Tap
enhanced.description: Landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

enhanced.name: Field Prep
enhanced.description: Greatly increases ammo generation. Improves reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.description: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

enhanced.name: Clown Cartridge
enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves to an improved degree.

perks.name: Firing Line
perks.description: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies.

enhanced.name: Firing Line
enhanced.description: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies. Handling is increased.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.description: Faster time to aim down sights.

enhanced.name: Snapshot Sights
enhanced.description: Faster time to aim down sights. Stability is increased.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.description: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

enhanced.name: Opening Shot
enhanced.description: Greatly improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

enhanced.name: Repulsor Brace
enhanced.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield that lasts for an improved duration.

perks.name: Box Breathing
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

enhanced.name: Box Breathing
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon for an improved short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

perks.name: Focused Fury
perks.description: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

enhanced.name: Focused Fury
enhanced.description: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage for an improved duration. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Frenzy
enhanced.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.
